edge_spec: {"edges":[{"bindings":"directory paths from task description","effect":"Agent confirms /app contains database/ and dbt_transforms/ directories","id":"explore_directory","operation":"ls -la and directory exploration commands","source":"initial_task_context","target":"directory_structure_discovered"},{"bindings":"dbt_transforms directory path","effect":"Agent discovers standard dbt project structure with models/, macros/, seeds/, etc.","id":"discover_project_structure","operation":"cd /app/dbt_transforms && ls -la","source":"directory_structure_discovered","target":"existing_project_explored"},{"bindings":"expected project path from task","effect":"Confirmed dbt_project directory does not exist at required location","id":"check_dbt_project_exists","operation":"ls -la /app/dbt_project","source":"directory_structure_discovered","target":"dbt_project_missing"},{"bindings":"project name from .","source":"profiles_configured","target":"dbt_debug_verified"},{"bindings":"database file path","effect":"Command failed with 'bash: duckdb: command not started, full parse due to missing manifest","id":"compile_model","operation":"dbt compile --select model_name","source":"dbt_deps_installed","target":"model_compilation_started"},{"bindings":"model SQL","source":"model_execution_in_progress","target":"model_execution_failed"},{"bindings":"model name, error details","effect":"Failed with 'Binder Error', 'Parser Error', or missing table/column error","id":"model_fails_syntax","operation":"dbt run with SQL syntax error","source":"model_execution_in_progress","target":"model_execution_failed"},{"bindings":"model name, schema","effect":"1 of 1 OK created sql table/view model schema.model_name [OK in X.XXs]","id":"model_succeeds","operation":"dbt run","source":"model_execution_in_progress","target":"model_execution_successful"},{"bindings":"table name, query","effect":"Verification script executed, may succeed or fail","id":"attempt_python_verification","operation":"python3 script with DuckDB queries","source":"model_execution_successful","target":"data_verification_attempted"},{"bindings":"error type","effect":"Failed with 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named numpy' or 'SyntaxError'","id":"python_verification_fails","operation":"python3 -c or script with missing module","source":"data_verification_attempted","target":"data_verification_failed"},{"bindings":"table name, verified metrics","effect":"Confirmed row count, column types, NULL counts, sample 5","source":"model_execution_successful","target":"data_verification_attempted"},{"bindings":"expected vs actual schema","effect":"Model created in wrong schema (e.g., analytics_analytics instead of change","source":"model_execution_successful","target":"schema_naming_issue"},{"bindings":"target schema","effect":"Model rebuilt in correct schema after macro override","id":"fix_schema_naming","operation":"Create generate_schema_name macro + dbt run --full-refresh","source":"schema_naming_issue","target":"model_rebuilt_with_fix"},{"bindings":"search _sources.yml","source":"existing_project_explored","target":"source_definitions_discovered"},{"bindings":"expected source name","effect":"No matching source definition found for expected applied","effect":"Model file updated to address type casting error","id":"fix_type_cast","operation":"Update SQL to use date_diff() or CAST with explicit types","source":"model_execution_failed","target":"model_rebuilt_with_fix"},{"bindings":"error type, fix applied","effect":"Model file updated with corrected JOINs, FROM clauses, or column references","id":"fix_sql_syntax","operation":"Update SQL to fix Binder Error or Parser Error","source":"model_execution_failed","target":"model_rebuilt_with_fix"},{"bindings":"model name","effect":"Model execution initiated after file update","id":"rebuild_after_fix","operation":"dbt run --select model_name or --full-refresh","source":"model_rebuilt_with_fix","target":"model_execution_in_progress"},{"bindings":"table name","effect":"Confirmed table contains 0 rows despite successful build","id":"check_row_count","operation":"python3 query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table","source":"model_execution_successful","target":"empty_result_set"},{"bindings":"model names, error details","effect":"Some models PASS, some ERROR, dependent models SKIP","id":"partial_run","operation":"dbt run with multiple models","source":"model_execution_in_progress","target":"partial_model_success"},{"bindings":"model name","effect":"dbt test command started, tests running","id":"run_tests","operation":"dbt test directories","id":"explore_initial","operation":"ls -la and directory listing commands","source":"initial_task_context","target":"directory_structure_discovered"},{"bindings":"dbt project path","effect":"Agent discovers existing dbt project with models/, macros/, seeds/, snapshots/, tests/ directories and dbt_project.yml","id":"explore_existing_project","operation":"cd to dbt project and ls directory structure","source":"initial_task_context","target":"existing_project_explored"},{"bindings":"model name or path","effect":"dbt run command initiated, adapter registered, parsing started","id":"run_model_after_deps","operation":"dbt run --select model_name","source":"dbt_deps_installed","target":"model_execution_in_progress"},{"bindings":"model name or path","effect":"dbt run command initiated after model file creation","id":"run_model_from_files","operation":"dbt run --select model_name","source":"model_files_created","target":"model_execution_in_progress"}]}
state_spec: {"router_instructions":"Route agent to appropriate knowledge state based on current environment understanding, task progress, and any blockers. States capture what the agent knows, what remains unknown, and what concrete obstacles exist. Do not route based on task identity or eventual success.","states":[{"description":"Agent is positioned at /app directory with task description. No exploration of directory structure, database contents, or dbt project has been performed yet.","exclusions":["directory structure verified","dbt project exists","database file confirmed"],"id":"initial_task_context","name":"Initial task context at /app"},{"description":"Agent has confirmed /app contains database/ and dbt_transforms/ directories. May or may not have verified retail.duckdb file existence.","exclusions":["dbt_project directory exists","duckdb CLI available for direct queries"],"id":"directory_structure_discovered","name":"Directory structure discovered"},{"description":"Task requires dbt project at /app/dbt_project but this directory does not exist. Must be created from scratch.","exclusions":["dbt project already exists at required location","dbt init completed"],"id":"dbt_project_missing","name":"Required dbt_project directory missing"},{"description":"dbt project directory created with default structure (models/, macros/, seeds/, etc.) and dbt_project.yml. May or may not have profiles.yml configured.","exclusions":["profiles.yml configured for target database","dbt deps installed","models created"],"id":"dbt_project_initialized","name":"dbt project initialized"},{"description":"profiles.yml created with DuckDB connection settings pointing to target database path and schema. Connection may or may not be verified.","exclusions":["connection test failed","dbt debug completed successfully"],"id":"profiles_configured","name":"Database connection configured"},{"description":"dbt debug command executed and confirmed profiles.yml and dbt_project.yml are valid, DuckDB connection successful, adapter registered.","exclusions":["models created","dbt run executed"],"id":"dbt_debug_verified","name":"dbt configuration and connection verified"},{"description":"Agent navigated to /app/dbt_transforms or similar and discovered standard dbt project structure with models/, macros/, seeds/, snapshots/, tests/ directories and dbt_project.yml.","exclusions":["dbt_project directory is the target","no project structure found"],"id":"existing_project_explored","name":"Existing dbt project structure explored"},{"description":"Agent attempted to use duckdb command-line tool but it is not installed or not in PATH. Cannot directly query database using duckdb CLI.","exclusions":["duckdb CLI functional","alternative database access method identified and working"],"id":"duckdb_cli_unavailable","name":"DuckDB CLI tool unavailable"},{"description":"packages.yml specifies required packages (e.g., dbt_utils) but dbt_packages directory is empty or packages not installed. Compilation will fail without deps.","exclusions":["dbt deps already run successfully","no packages required"],"id":"dbt_deps_needed","name":"dbt dependencies not installed"},{"description":"dbt deps executed successfully. Required packages (e.g., dbt_utils 1.3.3) available for model compilation and execution.","exclusions":["dbt run completed","model execution failed due to other causes"],"id":"dbt_deps_installed","name":"dbt dependencies installed"},{"description":"One or more dbt model files (staging, intermediate, or marts) created using heredoc or file write operations. Files exist but not yet compiled or materialized.","exclusions":["dbt run executed on these models","models successfully materialized"],"id":"model_files_created","name":"Model SQL files written to disk"},{"description":"dbt compile or dbt run command executed. Project parsing started (may show 'Starting full parse' due to missing manifest). Model execution pending.","exclusions":["compilation completed successfully","compilation failed with error"],"id":"model_compilation_started","name":"dbt compilation initiated"},{"description":"dbt run command executed, adapter registered, parsing started. No completion status (success or failure) observed yet. May show configuration warnings.","exclusions":["run completed successfully","run failed with error"],"id":"model_execution_in_progress","name":"dbt run parsing in progress"},{"description":"dbt run or compile failed with specific error (e.g., JULIANDAY function not found, INTERVAL cast error, schema case mismatch, Binder Error, missing table/column).","exclusions":["execution successful","execution still in progress"],"id":"model_execution_failed","name":"dbt model execution failed"},{"description":"dbt run completed with PASS status. Model materialized as view or table in database. May have WARN or SKIP but no ERROR for target model.","exclusions":["execution failed","execution still in progress"],"id":"model_execution_successful","name":"dbt model execution successful"},{"description":"Agent attempted to verify model output using python script, dbt show, or similar method. May have failed due to missing dependencies (numpy) or syntax errors.","exclusions":["verification successful","verification method not attempted"],"id":"data_verification_attempted","name":"Data verification method attempted"},{"description":"Verification attempt failed due to missing duckdb CLI, Python syntax error, missing module (numpy), or query execution error. Table contents not confirmed.","exclusions":["verification successful","verification not attempted"],"id":"data_verification_failed","name":"Data verification failed"},{"description":"Table structure, row count, column types, and/or sample data confirmed through python query or dbt show. Requirements met (e.g., correct column types, no NULLs, expected row counts).","exclusions":["verification failed","verification not attempted"],"id":"data_verified","name":"Model data verified"},{"description":"Model created in unexpected schema (e.g., double prefix like analytics_analytics, case sensitivity mismatch). Requires generate_schema_name macro or config fix.","exclusions":["schema naming correct","schema issue resolved"],"id":"schema_naming_issue","name":"Schema naming configuration issue"},{"description":"Agent discovered existing source.yml files in project (e.g., in staging/ directories). May have identified specific source names and schemas available for reference.","exclusions":["no source definitions exist","source definitions not searched"],"id":"source_definitions_discovered","name":"Source definition files found"},{"description":"grep search or file listing returned no results for expected source table. Table may need to be accessed via direct reference or source definition must be created.","exclusions":["source definition exists","source already searched and found"],"id":"source_definitions_not_found","name":"Source definition not found"},{"description":"Model failed due to DuckDB type casting limitation (e.g., INTERVAL to INTEGER, DATE to INTEGER, DOUBLE to DECIMAL). Requires alternative calculation method.","exclusions":["type casting successful","no type casting attempted"],"id":"column_type_error","name":"Column type casting error"},{"description":"Model failed due to SQL syntax error (e.g., missing FROM clause, Binder Error referencing undefined table/column, UNION ORDER BY issue). Requires SQL correction.","exclusions":["SQL syntax correct","error is type casting not syntax"],"id":"sql_syntax_error","name":"SQL syntax or logic error"},{"description":"Model file updated to address previous error (type casting, schema naming, SQL syntax, column names). dbt run --full-refresh or similar executed to rebuild.","exclusions":["fix not yet applied","original error still present"],"id":"model_rebuilt_with_fix","name":"Model rebuilt after fix"},{"description":"Model executes successfully but table contains 0 rows. Root cause may be JOIN mismatch, date range filter, or incorrect data conditions.","exclusions":["table has expected rows","table empty due to new model"],"id":"empty_result_set","name":"Model produces zero rows"},{"description":"Multiple models executed with some passing and some failing. Dependent models skipped due to upstream failure. Specific error identified for failed model.","exclusions":["all models succeeded","all models failed"],"id":"partial_model_success","name":"Partial model execution success"},{"description":"dbt test command executed. Tests running but not yet complete. May show some PASS/FAIL results but overall status unknown.","exclusions":["tests completed","test command not executed"],"id":"test_execution_started","name":"dbt test execution initiated"},{"description":"Agent verified all required SQL and YAML files exist in correct directories using ls, find, or cat commands. Summary printed confirming completion.","exclusions":["file structure not verified","required files missing"],"id":"project_file_structure_verified","name":"Project file structure confirmed"}]}
